items.title: Ukraine says military Starlink disrupted again as US envoys meet Putin in Moscow
items.description: Later on Thursday, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff will travel to Dublin to meet Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky.

items.title: 'We've got to run': Inside ruined Ukraine power plant under constant drone threat
items.description: Dan Johnson visits one of the country's largest power stations, barely left standing after a ballistic missile strike by Russia.

items.title: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools
items.description: Schools across Italy have received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking fresh panic and evacuations.

items.title: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century
items.description: In a state Trump won two years ago by 22 points, Colom's victory extends a string of Democratic wins in the Senate.

items.title: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says
items.description: Medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies, MSF warns

items.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
items.description: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.

items.title: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning
items.description: The girls started vomiting after eating oranges brought in by a fellow pupil - police are travelling to the village they came from.

items.title: British woman missing from cruise ship in Atlantic
items.description: The 72-year-old was last seen aboard the Tui ship on Monday as it headed towards the Caribbean.

items.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
items.description: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

items.title: Australian teen missing in bush for six days rescued alive
items.description: The 17-year-old's mum has joked that he is "grounded for life" and "never leaving the house again".

items.title: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
items.description: The news comes at a turbulent time for President Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.

items.title: Famed ship SS United States deliberately sunk off Florida coast to become a reef
items.description: Activists wanted the historic liner to be turned into a museum, but it will instead become the world's largest artificial ocean reef.
